No. 4 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.8631 of 2025, I.A.No.3 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.2328 of 2024, I.A.No.2 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.2613 of 2024 are filed by the De-facto complainant/respondent No.2 seeking to record the compromise and quash the PRC No.3/2021 on file of the II Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate court, Eluru, West Godavari District.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate court, Eluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 05. Today, when the matter was taken up for hearing, the petitioners/accused Nos.2, 3 and 6 and respondent No. 1/de-facto complainant were present before this Court.
Accused Nos.1, 4 and 5 were appeared in virtual mode.
They produced their respective attested copies of Aadhar cards in proof of their identity, and the same were placed on record for proper identification.
Both the learned counsel on record identified both the parties in open Court.
06. Ms. K. Priyanka Lakshmi, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the State, is in attendance and reported no objection to record the compromise.
07. This Court enquired the de-facto complainant about her willingness to enter into compromise in the matter.
She represented before the Court that she has voluntarily come forward for the compromise.
The de-facto complainant further submitted that the case may be closed against the accused Nos.1 to 6.
She does not want to prosecute the matter.
The accused Nos.1 to 6 handed over the Demand Draft bearing No.621023 dated 01.10.2025 for Rupees Fifteen Lakh Only to the victim/de-facto complainant before the Court.

08. Considering the submissions and in the light of the judgment of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and another 1, 2012(10)SCC 303 since there is an amicable settlement between the parties, in the interest of justice, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.8631 of 2025,
I.A.No.2 and 3 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.2328 of 2024, I.A.No.1 and 2 of 2025 in Crl.P.No.2613 of 2024 are allowed.
